senses.gloss: पथ् PATH, cs. api-pāthaya, P. bring into 🞄a path (ac.).
पथ path-a, m. way, road, path (—˚).
पथिक pathi-ka, m. wanderer, traveller: 🞄-sārtha, m. company of travellers.

पाथस् pā́th-as, n. place;
 water: -pati, m. 🞄lord of the waters, ep. of Varuṇa.
पाथेय pātheya, n. victuals for a journey 🞄(pathi): -vat, a. having anything as provisions 🞄for the journey, victualed with (—˚).
